title: frappeforge-codegen config
description: Settings for frappeforge-codegen, in frappeforge.json. Command-line flags win over environment variables, which win over this file; DocType, module and app lists are combined from this file and the flags. Without a site URL, the DocTypes are read from the Frappe bench this file is in. Credentials never go here: they are read only from FRAPPE_API_KEY and FRAPPE_API_SECRET.

url.description: The site's URL, such as "https://example.com". Overridden by --url and FRAPPE_URL. Without one, the DocTypes are read from the source of the apps of the Frappe bench this file is in.

siteName.description: The site's name, sent as X-Frappe-Site-Name, when the URL's host is not the site's name. Overridden by --site-name and FRAPPE_SITE_NAME.

doctypes.description: DocTypes to generate, by name, such as "Customer". Their child tables are included.

modules.description: Modules whose DocTypes are all generated, such as "Selling".

apps.description: Apps whose DocTypes are all generated, such as "erpnext": apps installed on the site, or apps of the bench.

out.description: The output file, relative to this file. Overridden by --out, which is relative to the current folder.

register.description: Augment @frappeforge/client's Register with the generated DocTypes, so createClient() is typed without a type argument. --no-register turns it off.

rename.description: Interface names to use instead of the derived ones, by DocType, such as { "Item": "ErpItem" }.
